about.title: A committed and recognized Ivorian company
about.paragraph1: Based in Nanan, next to the Holidays Hotel in Yamoussoukro, KANYEL SARL supports individuals, companies, and institutions in their land subdivision and development projects, construction, international trade, and logistics. Our strength lies in the diversity of our fields of activity, united by the same standard of seriousness, rigor, and trust.
about.paragraph2: Under the leadership of its Chief Executive Officer, the company relies on a strong network of partners, an organization structured into specialized departments, and a constant commitment to quality — delivering reliable service from the first contact through to the completion of every project.
about.ceoMessage: Since establishing ourselves in Yamoussoukro, we have chosen rigor and closeness with each of our clients. Whether in land subdivision, construction, import-export, transport, or trading, our standard remains the same: delivering serious work, on time and true to our commitments. This conviction guides every project we undertake, large or small.
about.cred1Desc: Haut Patronat des Commerçants et Opérateurs Économiques de Côte d'Ivoire (High Patronage of Traders and Economic Operators of Côte d'Ivoire) — Departmental Delegate for the city of Yamoussoukro.
about.cred2Desc: International Humanitarian Network for Equitable Development — "A Just and Equitable World."
about.cred3Desc: A firm commitment to quality and international standards across the group's activities.

services.title: Our departments, one standard of quality
services.quote: One commitment across every trade: your success
services.subtitle: KANYEL SARL organizes its activities into specialized departments, complemented by diverse services tailored to each client's specific needs.
services.item1Desc: Land subdivision, servicing, and development, plus support in land acquisition and title security for individuals, developers, and investors.
services.item2Desc: Construction of residential, commercial, and administrative buildings, as well as road works and utility networks (VRD).
services.item3Desc: Sourcing and trading of goods between Côte d'Ivoire and international markets, backed by a network of reliable partners.
services.item4Desc: Organization of goods transport and logistics management, from loading to delivery, securing every step of the supply chain.
services.item5Desc: Trading and marketing of various goods, with a reliable intermediation service between suppliers and clients.
services.item6Desc: Rental management, property enhancement, and day-to-day oversight of real estate assets on behalf of owners and investors, ensuring profitability and peace of mind.
services.footnote: Every department is led with the same rigor, quality, and respect for deadlines.

why.title: A multi-sector partner, one trusted signature
why.subtitle: Six concrete reasons to entrust your project to KANYEL SARL, from the first conversation through to delivery.
why.item1Desc: Several complementary departments to address varied needs through a single point of contact.
why.item2Desc: Based in Yamoussoukro, the political capital of Côte d'Ivoire, with activities extending into international import-export.
why.item3Desc: Leadership engaged in ISO certification processes and international standards.
why.item4Desc: Leadership involved in recognized economic and humanitarian bodies (HPCO-CI, RIHDE).
why.item5Desc: From initial consultation to final delivery, rigorous follow-up at every stage of your project.
why.item6Desc: A client relationship built on listening, clear commitments, and respect for deadlines.
